title: Sync Project Brain v1 shared cross-session context
description: Sync the reviewed Project Brain v1 implementation from GitHub main into the AI Studio workspace. Sync ONLY these files: server/projectBrain.ts, server/projectBrainRoutes.ts, server/workspaceTaskRouter.ts, server.ts, tests/projectBrain.test.ts, package.json, .bridge/brain/PROJECT_STATE.json, and .bridge/brain/README.md. Preserve any Studio-specific deployment/startup adaptation unless the GitHub version is already compatible. Project Brain separates shared durable project knowledge from per-session scratch, exposes authenticated bootstrap/memory/handoff endpoints, loads the repo-backed snapshot plus runtime memory, and injects project_context into every Studio claim response even when no task is available. Run npm run lint, npm test, npm run build, restart Preview, verify GET /health reports project_brain: ready, and verify a Studio claim response contains project_context with workspace/project/goal/shared memory/task summary. Do not redesign the UI and do not Publish. Submit the result through Studio Relay.
